description.translate: Bring eight redstone dust for the comparison bench fittings. We will restore the old signal indicators; no automated verdict will replace reading the records ourselves. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The alteration predates The Ranker's final expedition to capture the Inferno's power. Someone interfered with his support equipment and escort. His decision to depart before the work was ready remains his own. The records establish interference; they do not identify its author.
